content: For older children and adults, the preferred site for a deep intramuscular (IM) injection is the upper outer quadrant of the buttock. When administering this type of injection, it is important to inject at a slow and steady rate to prevent the needle from becoming blocked, as the medication may contain a high concentration of suspended particles. The medication should be stored in a refrigerator at a temperature of 2–8 degrees Celsius (36–46 degrees Fahrenheit) and must not be frozen. When comparing formulary statuses of medications within the same class, it is helpful to create a list of plans. This list can be saved and edited as needed. Adding plans allows for a more comprehensive comparison of formulary information. However, it is important to note that the information provided is for general informational and educational purposes only. Formulary details may vary between individual plans and are subject to change. For the most accurate and up-to-date information, contact the relevant plan provider directly.
